title: Mechanical properties of low-density, refractory multi-principal element alloys of the Cr–Nb–Ti–V–Zr system
process_method_2: vacuum arc melting + hot isostatic pressing-annealing
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of the nominal mixtures of the corresponding elements, hot isostatically pressed at 1473 K and 207 MPa for 2 h and then annealed at 1473 K for 24 h in a high-purity argon
